extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia users/editors attempting to create a new article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for contributors trying to create a new Wikipedia page (here: an article titled 'Trump 2025 jokes'), including account requirements, searching for existing content, naming conventions, and what to do if a page is missing or deleted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed status required to create pages
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only registered users who meet the autoconfirmed threshold can create articles directly. If you are not logged in or autoconfirmed, follow alternative submission paths (see next criterion).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article if you cannot create pages
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributors who cannot create pages because of account restrictions should submit drafts via the article wizard or use the 'request a new article' process so experienced editors can review and create the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for 'Trump 2025 jokes' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, ensure the topic isn't already covered under a different title or spelling to avoid duplicates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding incoming links can reveal existing coverage, appropriate contexts, or the correct canonical title; it may be better to create or modify a redirect rather than a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newly created pages may be temporarily invisible (database delay)
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you think the page was already created, wait briefly and/or use the purge function to refresh. Do not recreate a page immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case sensitivity and redirect creation
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and set up redirects where needed so readers find the article under common spellings/capitalizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if the page was removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review the deletion reason and guidance in the deletion log before attempting to recreate the article; follow any instructions for addressing issues or appealing deletions.
